newsitem.title: UK: China seen as aluminium growth market - Alumax AM.
newsitem.headline: China seen as aluminium growth market - Alumax AM.

text.p: China is seen as a rapid growth area for aluminium, hence the decision some three years ago by Alumax Inc to explore that emerging market, Philippe Thaure, President of Alumax International Co said.
He said that Alumax found that aluminium demand in China was growing much faster than in the North American and Western European markets.
"Our studies found that consumption of aluminium is increasing in China in part because of its growing middle class," Thaure said at the Financial Times World Aluminium Conference.
Whereas U.S. per capita consumption of aluminium is 66/lbs annually, in China the figure is only three lbs per capita.
"Obviously there is great room for growth as the Chinese economy modernizes and its middle class strengthens," he said.

Alumax itself has established a $70 million joint venture agreement with Yunnan Processing Factory to form Yunnan Xinmeilu Aluminium Foil Co Ltd, which can produce up to 10,000 tonnes of light-gauge aluminium foil for packaging.
"We are also working on a second joint venture with a company in Shanghai to set up an architectural products facility,' Thaure added.
